verdict.rationale: Square exposes a Disputes API (retrieve, process disputes, sandbox testing) and the Square MCP server's service catalog explicitly includes 'disputes' with generic API-call tools (get_service_info, make_api_request), which would let an agent programmatically retrieve and act on disputes. However, no evidence details evidence-assembly/submission mechanics or shows an end-to-end agent-run dispute workflow. Missing for 10: documentation of a dispute-evidence submission endpoint, a demonstrated end-to-end agent workflow, and independent confirmation of successful automated dispute handling.
